metadata.description: Mizan agent skills — package Mizan's evaluation, authoring, and results workflows as model-invoked skills that drive the mizan CLI over -o json, with mizan now also reachable over MCP via its mizan mcp server.

plugins.name: mizan-eval
plugins.description: Run Mizan evaluations from an agent: score a single response or compare two responses against a metric template via the mizan CLI, reasoning over the -o json result. Use when you need to evaluate an asset/response against guidance and explain the verdict.

plugins.name: mizan-results
plugins.description: Turn stored Mizan eval results into a self-contained, standalone HTML report from an agent: query results via the mizan CLI over -o json, aggregate client-side, and render a single offline report.html. Use when you need to review, summarize, or visualize past evaluation results as an HTML report.

plugins.name: mizan-setup
plugins.description: Configure Mizan for first use from an agent: inspect the resolved configuration via the mizan CLI over -o json, persist project/location/default-model/results-store settings with `config set`, verify the CLI build with `version`, and check (never store) Application Default Credentials. Use when you need to set up or verify a Mizan environment before running live evaluations.

plugins.name: mizan-authoring
plugins.description: Author metric-template packs for Mizan from an agent: scaffold a pack, create boul/choice/score/rubric/pointwise/pairwise/custom_schema/heuristic templates via the mizan CLI, validate the pack creds-free (the CI PR gate), and run the export->PR->import collaborator loop; and generate a rubric from a brand book (suggest-first, agent-side synthesis) then freeze it into the registry. Use when you need to author, package, validate, or share a Mizan metric template or template pack, or to generate evaluation rubrics from a brand book or guidance document.

plugins.name: mizan-mcp
plugins.description: Expose the Mizan eval engine to agents and MCP clients as callable tools via the `mizan mcp` server. Registers a local stdio MCP server (`mizan mcp stdio`) advertising four tools — mizan_list_metrics, mizan_get_metric (read-only), mizan_eval_run, and mizan_eval_pairwise — plus an agent-in-the-loop eval skill. Use when an agent should discover a judge and run an evaluation over MCP rather than shelling out to the CLI.
